notes.title: A case, not a message
notes.quote: Add messages, call notes, links and screenshots as they arrive; each one re-evaluates the case.

notes.title: Local OCR
notes.quote: a screenshot read locally with Tesseract (image never stored)

notes.title: Payments untouched
notes.quote: It never sees, blocks or approves a real payment, and it consults no bank or NPCI data.

notes.title: Alert discipline
notes.quote: unchanged evidence is suppressed; alerts fire only when risk rises or a new high-weight tactic appears

notes.title: No paid model
notes.quote: No paid API, API key or external model is needed.

notes.title: Measured, with its caveat
notes.quote: precision 0.885 (23/26), recall 0.958 (23/24), false-positive rate 0.111 (3/27); keyword baseline 0.826 / 0.792 / 0.148. Synthetic results do not show real-world accuracy.

notes.title: Stated limit
notes.quote: Risk scores are heuristic indicators from transparent rules, not calibrated probabilities of fraud.

notes.title: Intent in
notes.quote: You describe an outcome in plain language.

notes.title: Approval gate
notes.quote: Nothing runs before approval.

notes.title: Independent verification
notes.quote: It then independently verifies every file and every quoted fact before it reports back.

notes.title: Cited reasoning
notes.quote: Every claim must cite observation ids that exist; uncited claims are discarded and counted.

notes.title: No invented zeros
notes.quote: Missing prices are reported as "Not found", never as zero.

notes.title: Stated limit
notes.quote: Verification proves file integrity and that quotes match the stored pages. It does not prove that vendor claims are true or current.

repos.name: pramaan
repos.description: PraMaan — an AI-powered, evidence-backed packaged commodity compliance checker using multilingual OCR and a deterministic, versioned Legal Metrology rule engine.

head.message: Fix physical-iOS scan upload: replace broken fetch()+FormData with expo-file-system UploadTask

stages.quote: Product photo → preprocessing → label region → multilingual OCR → field extraction → deterministic rule engine (versioned rule pack) → verdict → evidence + legal clause → confidence gate → human review → audit trail

layers.name: API
layers.quote: FastAPI, JWT auth, role-based authorization on every protected route

layers.name: Pipeline
layers.quote: Preprocessing (OpenCV) → label detection (honest full-image fallback) → OCR (real Tesseract) → extraction (regex, English + Hindi keywords) → rule engine → verdict

layers.name: Mobile app
layers.quote: React Native + Expo + TypeScript, one app for both Citizen and Inspector roles

layers.name: Data
layers.quote: SQLAlchemy ORM; SQLite for local dev, PostgreSQL verified for production

notes.title: The central principle
notes.quote: AI/CV does observation ("what text appears to be on this label?"); it never decides law.

notes.title: No LLM in the verdict
notes.quote: No LLM is anywhere in that decision path

notes.title: Law as data
notes.quote: Every legal number (tolerance percentages, band thresholds) is data in rule_pack_v1.json, not a Python constant.

notes.title: Replayable verdicts
notes.quote: Every scan stores rule_pack_version + a SHA-256 rule_pack_hash of the exact file bytes used.

notes.title: Uncertainty goes to a person
notes.quote: a field below CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (default 60%) or not found at all becomes REVIEW, never a silently-invented PASS/FAIL.

notes.title: Tests
notes.quote: 117 tests, 117 passing, 1 intentionally skipped

notes.title: Stated limit
notes.quote: OCR-level determinism is NOT guaranteed across different Tesseract builds

head.message: docs: update project setup and usage guide

stages.quote: it analyzes the codebase, plans a fix, edits files through an audited tool layer, runs the repository's real test suite, diagnoses failures, repairs its own implementation across bounded retries, and reports a real diff

notes.title: Core principle
notes.quote: never simulate an operation that didn't actually happen.

notes.title: Sandbox
notes.quote: non-root, no network, read-only root filesystem, resource limits, dropped capabilities

notes.title: No guessed costs
notes.quote: an unpriced model reports null, never a guessed cost
